# lakekeeper_generic_table (Resource)

The `lakekeeper_generic_table` resource manages a generic (non-Iceberg) table inside a Lakekeeper namespace. Lakekeeper catalogs the table's identity, location and governance; engines such as Lance and Delta read and write the data directly.

Lakekeeper has no update operation for generic tables. Changing `namespace`, `format`, `base_location`, `doc`, `properties` or `schema` replaces the table; changing `name` renames it in place.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/generic-table/#tag/generic-table/operation/create_generic_table)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lakekeeper_generic_table" "embeddings" {
  project_id     = "891d18c8-1da4-471e-89f1-6e43eb4dcb38"
  warehouse_name = "warehouse_example"
  namespace      = "ml.images"
  name           = "embeddings"
  format         = "lance"
  doc            = "Image embeddings written by the ML pipeline"

  properties = {
    owner = "ml-platform"
  }

  schema = jsonencode({
    type = "struct"
    fields = [
      { name = "id", type = "long" },
      { name = "embedding", type = "list<float>" },
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `format` (String) The table format, for example `lance`, `delta` or `dataset`. Lakekeeper treats this as an opaque string.
- `name` (String) The name of the table. Changing it renames the table in place.
- `namespace` (String) The dotted path of the namespace, including all parent levels, for example `sales.bronze`.
- `project_id` (String) The internal ID of the project where the table is located.
- `warehouse_name` (String) The name of the warehouse where the table is located.

### Optional

- `base_location` (String) The base location of the table. When omitted, Lakekeeper derives it from the warehouse storage. Lakekeeper stores locations without trailing slashes; the provider treats a trailing slash as equivalent. Changing it replaces the table.
- `doc` (String) A free-form description of the table. Changing it replaces the table. On import, omitting it keeps the stored value; set it to an empty string to clear it.
- `properties` (Map of String) Arbitrary string properties stored with the table. Changing them replaces the table. On import, omitting them keeps the stored values; set them to an empty map to clear them.
- `purge_on_delete` (Boolean) Whether destroying this resource also deletes the files under the table's base location. Defaults to `false`, so a destroy only removes the catalog entry; set it to `true` to delete the data files as well.
- `schema` (String) The table schema as a JSON document. Lakekeeper stores it as informational metadata and does not validate it against the data files. Changing it replaces the table. On import, omitting it keeps the stored value.

### Read-Only

- `generic_table_id` (String) The generic table UUID used by the protection and permission APIs.
- `id` (String) The ID of the generic table, in the form `{{project_id}}/{{warehouse_name}}/{{namespace}}/{{name}}`.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the table is protected from being dropped. Lakekeeper refuses to drop a protected table, so remove the protection before destroying this resource.
- `warehouse_id` (String) The UUID of the warehouse. Use it with the protection and permission APIs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# id is "{{project_id}}/{{warehouse_name}}/{{namespace}}/{{name}}"
# Omit doc, properties and schema (or match the stored values) after import:
# setting different values replaces the table. purge_on_delete defaults to
# false, so a replacement keeps the data files.
terraform import lakekeeper_generic_table.embeddings "891d18c8-1da4-471e-89f1-6e43eb4dcb38/warehouse_example/ml.images/embeddings"
```
